keyEvents.text: Gonzalo Luján (Inter Miami CF) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, New England Revolution 0, Inter Miami CF 0.
Goal! New England Revolution 1, Inter Miami CF 0. Dániel Gazdag (New England Revolution) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Ilay Feingold.
Substitution, Inter Miami CF. Matías Galarza replaces Yannick Bright.
Substitution, Inter Miami CF. Sergio Reguilón replaces Gonzalo Luján.
Goal! New England Revolution 1, Inter Miami CF 1. Germán Berterame (Inter Miami CF) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Lionel Messi with a headed pass.
Substitution, Inter Miami CF. Luis Suárez replaces Riquelme Fillipi.
Matías Galarza (Inter Miami CF) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, New England Revolution. Alhassan Yusuf replaces Ilay Feingold.
Goal! New England Revolution 1, Inter Miami CF 2. Lionel Messi (Inter Miami CF) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Telasco Segovia.
Substitution, New England Revolution. Luca Langoni replaces Matt Polster.
Telasco Segovia (Inter Miami CF) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Inter Miami CF. David Ayala replaces Germán Berterame.
Substitution, Inter Miami CF. Facundo Mura replaces Telasco Segovia.
Substitution, New England Revolution. Diego Fagúndez replaces Ethan Kohler.
Luca Langoni (New England Revolution) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
